title: Market integration and regime shifts in WTI and Brent crude oil Markets
title_zh: WTI与布伦特原油市场的市场整合与制度变迁
title_primary: WTI与布伦特原油市场的市场整合与制度变迁
title_secondary: Market integration and regime shifts in WTI and Brent crude oil Markets
authors: Hyun Jin Jang, Robert I. Webb, Seokju Kang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the cointegration between WTI and Brent crude oil prices across spot and futures markets over 1993–2022. We analyse four price pairs to assess market integration and price discovery, while developing a cointegration parity consistency framework linking the estimated bivariate cointegration structures across interconnected markets. We find strong evidence of a stable long-run equilibrium in spot markets, confirming tight global integration. In contrast, futures relationships are less stable and vary across sub-sample periods. Three structural shifts drive these dynamics: (i) post-2003 divergence of futures from spot relationships amid increased market participation, (ii) a 2015 shift in price discovery from Brent to WTI following U.S. export liberalization, and (iii) a marked weakening of spot–futures linkages since 2019 during heightened global uncertainty. Finally, the tests reveal no statistically detectable cross-system inconsistency among the estimated cointegrating relationships, illustrating the role of the proposed parity consistency framework as a system-level diagnostic. These findings highlight how institutional changes and global shocks shape price linkages and market integration in crude oil markets. KEYWORDS: Cointegration parity consistency vector error correction method West Texas Intermediate brent regime shifts in long-run relationship JEL CLASSIFICATION: G14 C19 Q43
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了1993年至2022年间WTI与布伦特原油价格在现货与期货市场上的协整关系。我们分析了四组价格配对，以评估市场一体化与价格发现机制，同时构建了一个协整套利一致性框架，将跨关联市场的估计双变量协整结构联系起来。研究发现，现货市场存在稳定的长期均衡关系的有力证据，确认了全球市场的紧密一体化。相比之下，期货市场的关系稳定性较弱，且在不同子样本期间有所变化。三个结构性转变驱动了这些动态变化：（i）2003年后，随着市场参与度提升，期货与现货关系出现分化；（ii）2015年，在美国出口自由化后，价格发现主导权从布伦特转向WTI；（iii）自2019年以来，在全球不确定性加剧的背景下，现货与期货之间的联动关系显著减弱。最后，检验结果显示，所估计的协整关系之间不存在统计上可检测的跨系统不一致性，这体现了所提出的协整套利一致性框架作为系统层面诊断工具的作用。这些发现凸显了制度变迁与全球冲击如何塑造原油市场的价格联动与市场一体化。关键词：协整套利一致性 向量误差修正方法 西德克萨斯中质原油 布伦特 长期关系中的制度转变 JEL分类：G14 C19 Q43

title: The 40-Hour Work Week
title_zh: 每周40小时工作制
title_primary: 每周40小时工作制
title_secondary: The 40-Hour Work Week
authors: Ma, Eunseong
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This study examines the implications of the traditional 40-hour work week using an incomplete-markets model that incorporates both the extensive and intensive margins of labor supply, along with a wage penalty for working fewer hours than a specified threshold. The 40-hour standard emerges as a key driver of labor supply elasticities: micro-level elasticities remain small, whereas macro-level elasticities are larger, reflecting adjustment that occurs primarily along the extensive margin. Households constrained by the 40-hour schedule face the adverse welfare effects of business cycle fluctuations, as the rigid schedule limits their ability to adjust hours in response to wage changes.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用一个包含劳动供给广延边际与集约边际以及低于特定工时阈值时工资惩罚的不完全市场模型，探讨传统每周40小时工作制的含义。40小时标准成为劳动供给弹性的关键驱动因素：微观层面的弹性保持较小，而宏观层面的弹性则较大，反映出调整主要沿广延边际发生。受40小时工作制约束的家庭面临商业周期波动的不利福利影响，因为刚性工作安排限制了其根据工资变化调整工时的能力。

title: Differing environmental preferences, fiscal competition, and taxation of goods and pollution
title_zh: 环境偏好差异、财政竞争与商品及污染税收
title_primary: 环境偏好差异、财政竞争与商品及污染税收
title_secondary: Differing environmental preferences, fiscal competition, and taxation of goods and pollution
authors: Helmuth Cremer, Firouz Gahvari
official: 官方在线 2026-08-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a two-country model of trade and global pollution in which country A values environmental quality whereas country B does not. Governments choose emissions and commodity taxes non-cooperatively under autarky and free trade. Under autarky, the principle of targeting holds: country A levies a Pigouvian emissions tax, whereas neither country uses a commodity tax. Opening borders fundamentally changes the design of corrective taxation. Country A subsidizes the polluting good to shift production toward its cleaner firms. The optimal subsidy depends on the marginal social damage of emissions despite the presence of an emissions tax, implying a violation of the principle of targeting. Contrary to the conventional pollution-haven prediction, the environmentally unconcerned country need not be the exporter of the polluting good. As country A's valuation of environmental quality increases, or country B's production-cost advantage narrows, production shifts toward $A$, which eventually becomes the exporter. Beyond a critical threshold, trade reduces global emissions relative to autarky. Welfare effects are asymmetric: trade always benefits country B but may either increase or decrease welfare in country A.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个两国贸易与全球污染模型，其中A国重视环境质量，而B国不重视。在自给自足和自由贸易条件下，两国政府非合作地选择排放税和商品税。在自给自足状态下，目标原则成立：A国征收庇古式排放税，而两国均不采用商品税。开放边界从根本上改变了矫正性税收的设计。A国对污染性商品提供补贴，以将生产转向其更清洁的企业。尽管存在排放税，最优补贴仍取决于排放的边际社会损害，这违反了目标原则。与传统污染避难所预测相反，不关心环境的B国未必是污染性商品的出口国。随着A国对环境质量评价的提高，或B国生产成本优势的缩小，生产向A国转移，最终A国成为出口国。超过临界阈值后，贸易相对于自给自足降低了全球排放。福利效应不对称：贸易总是惠及B国，但可能提高或降低A国的福利。

title: Weathering hard times with bushmeat: rural household coping under rainfall shocks
title_zh: 以丛林肉应对艰难时期：降雨冲击下农村家庭的应对策略
title_primary: 以丛林肉应对艰难时期：降雨冲击下农村家庭的应对策略
title_secondary: Weathering hard times with bushmeat: rural household coping under rainfall shocks
authors: Prachi Jhamb, Susana Ferreira, Martin Reinhardt Nielsen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: While bushmeat can be a crucial protein source for food insecure households, its consumption and trade raise significant concerns for both human health and wildlife conservation. Here we investigate how rainfall shocks influence rural households’ income from and reliance on bushmeat hunting. Drawing on data from nearly 8,000 rural households across 24 low- and middle-income countries, matched to gridded rainfall records and detailed agricultural season calendars, our study distinguishes between the effects of shocks depending on their type, intensity and timing of occurrence within the agricultural cycle. We mitigate endogeneity concerns faced in prior studies relying on self-reported shocks and cross-sectional data, by constructing a quarterly household panel survey integrated with objective, high-resolution data on climatic moisture stress. We find that dry conditions increase both bushmeat income and its share in total household income, particularly during critical agricultural periods. Conversely, wet conditions have the opposite effect, often decreasing hunting due to improved agricultural yields. However, these effects vary depending on the intensity of wet conditions. Additionally, we find heterogeneity in responses across socio-economic strata, as wealthier households tend to have higher bushmeat income during dry periods, likely due to better access to resources. The study increases our understanding of when and by whom climate stressors induce greater wildlife offtake, providing important insight for targeted development and conservation policy.
abstract_zh: 尽管丛林肉对于粮食不安全的家庭而言可能是关键的蛋白质来源，但其消费和贸易对人类健康与野生动物保护均构成重大关切。本研究探讨了降雨冲击如何影响农村家庭从丛林肉狩猎中获得的收入及其依赖程度。基于覆盖24个中低收入国家近8000户农村家庭的数据，结合网格化降雨记录和详细的农业季节日历，我们的研究区分了冲击类型、强度及其在农业周期内发生时间的不同影响。通过构建季度家庭面板调查，并整合关于气候水分胁迫的客观高分辨率数据，我们缓解了先前依赖自我报告冲击和横截面数据的研究所面临的内生性问题。研究发现，干旱条件增加了丛林肉收入及其在家庭总收入中的占比，尤其是在关键农业时期。相反，湿润条件则产生相反效果，通常因农业产量提高而减少狩猎活动。然而，这些效应随湿润条件强度的不同而变化。此外，我们观察到不同社会经济阶层间的反应存在异质性，较富裕家庭在干旱时期往往拥有更高的丛林肉收入，这可能归因于其更好的资源获取能力。本研究增进了我们对气候压力何时以及由谁引发更大野生动物捕获量的理解，为有针对性的发展和保护政策提供了重要见解。

title: Two-person zero-sum games without expected utility preferences: a proposal
title_zh: 无期望效用偏好下的两人零和博弈：一个提议
title_primary: 无期望效用偏好下的两人零和博弈：一个提议
title_secondary: Two-person zero-sum games without expected utility preferences: a proposal
authors: Siddharth Chatterjee
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A solution concept for two-person zero-sum games is proposed with only the axiom of Independence assumed of players’ preferences. Each player is shown to admit a set of admissible strategies assuring minimum guarantees. Rationality requires agents to reject non-admissible strategies in further considerations. Knowledge assumptions imply iterated elimination of non-admissible strategies resulting in surviving sets whose Cartesian product form consideration equilibria which is nonempty and includes any Nash equilibrium, if one exists. It coincides with the set of Nash equilibria or minimax strategy tuples if preferences additionally satisfy Continuity. Further, consideration equilibria of a game are contained in the set of minimax strategy tuples of the continuous approximation of the given game.
abstract_zh: 针对两人零和博弈，提出了一种仅假设玩家偏好满足独立性公理时的解概念。每位玩家被证明拥有一组确保最低收益保证的可接受策略。理性要求参与者在进一步考虑中排除非可接受策略。知识假设意味着对非可接受策略进行迭代剔除，最终存活的策略集合的笛卡尔积构成考虑均衡，该均衡非空，并且若存在纳什均衡，则包含所有纳什均衡。若偏好额外满足连续性，则该均衡与纳什均衡集或极小极大策略组合集一致。此外，博弈的考虑均衡包含于给定博弈的连续逼近的极小极大策略组合集中。

title: Economic Implication of the Iran-Israel Conflict on Pakistan: Trade, Energy, and Remittance Perspectives (2023-2026)
title_zh: 伊朗-以色列冲突对巴基斯坦的经济影响：贸易、能源与侨汇视角（2023-2026）
title_primary: 伊朗-以色列冲突对巴基斯坦的经济影响：贸易、能源与侨汇视角（2023-2026）
title_secondary: Economic Implication of the Iran-Israel Conflict on Pakistan: Trade, Energy, and Remittance Perspectives (2023-2026)
authors: Joheera
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how the Iran-Israel conflict, and the Middle East tension in general, have affected the Pakistani economy in terms of trade, energy, and remittance. Being an energy-import dependent and export-oriented economy with a large diaspora in Gulf countries, Pakistan is prone to global oil price shocks, oil disruptions along important energy routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and possible drops in remittance inflows. Pakistan saw a potential resolution of an impact on retail fuel prices of about 20 percent in 2023-2026, with an increment of petrol and diesel of 55 per Pak rupee, which has increased inflation and aggravated the trade deficit. This paper illustrates the spread of global political events in domestic economic forces using international trade theory, macroeconomic shock theory and remittance development theory. In order to reduce the risk in the short run and increase resilience in the long-term, it is recommended to diversify the trade, establish energy security measures, formal remittance protection, and implement sound fiscal and monetary policies. The paper highlights the economic fragility of Pakistan to external shocks and outlines feasible measures to help it maintain a growth and stability in the current geopolitical instability.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了伊朗-以色列冲突及整个中东紧张局势如何通过贸易、能源和侨汇渠道影响巴基斯坦经济。作为一个依赖能源进口、以出口为导向且在海湾国家拥有大量侨民的经济体，巴基斯坦易受全球油价冲击、霍尔木兹海峡等重要能源通道中断以及侨汇流入可能下降的影响。巴基斯坦预计在2023-2026年间零售燃油价格可能受到约20%的影响，汽油和柴油每巴基斯坦卢比上涨55%，这加剧了通货膨胀并恶化了贸易逆差。本文运用国际贸易理论、宏观经济冲击理论和侨汇发展理论，阐释了全球政治事件在国内经济力量中的传导机制。为降低短期风险并增强长期韧性，建议实现贸易多元化、建立能源安全措施、完善侨汇保障机制，并实施稳健的财政和货币政策。本文凸显了巴基斯坦对外部冲击的经济脆弱性，并提出了在当前地缘政治不稳定背景下帮助其维持增长与稳定的可行措施。

title: Common Ownership and Collusion
title_zh: 共同所有权与合谋
title_primary: 共同所有权与合谋
title_secondary: Common Ownership and Collusion
authors: Florian Ederer, Vincent Abraham, Catarina Marvão
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence that common ownership can facilitate explicit collusion. Our unique setting, the population of legal cartels in Sweden, lets us observe cartel formation, duration, and dissolution without the sample-selection bias that plagues studies of detected cartels. Combining hand-collected ownership data with the universe of registered cartels, we compute firm-pair profit weights (κ) that measure how much one firm internalizes a rival's profits. Higher profit weights are associated with a greater likelihood of cartel participation, predict future cartel involvement, and are linked to longer cartel duration. Firms also reduce their profit weights immediately after a cartel dissolves. However, this relationship is concentrated among pairs in which the firm that internalizes the rival firm's profits colludes while the rival does not. Common ownership therefore complements a firm’s own participation in explicit collusion but substitutes for cartel participation by the rival whose profits it internalizes.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了首个经验证据，表明共同所有权能促进显性共谋。我们的独特研究背景——瑞典合法卡特尔全体样本，使我们能够观察卡特尔的形成、持续与解散，而避免了困扰已侦测卡特尔研究的样本选择偏差。结合手工收集的所有权数据与全部注册卡特尔，我们计算了企业配对利润权重（κ），该指标衡量一家企业在多大程度上内化竞争对手的利润。更高的利润权重与卡特尔参与可能性增大相关，能预测未来卡特尔参与，并与更长的卡特尔持续时间相关联。企业还在卡特尔解散后立即降低其利润权重。然而，这种关系集中在那些内化对手利润的企业参与共谋而对手未参与的企业配对中。因此，共同所有权补充了企业自身在显性共谋中的参与，但替代了其利润被内化的竞争对手的卡特尔参与。

title: How to Replace Public Communication with Private One
title_zh: 如何用私人沟通替代公共沟通
title_primary: 如何用私人沟通替代公共沟通
title_secondary: How to Replace Public Communication with Private One
authors: Helmuts Āzacis, Péter Vida
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A sender wants to make a public announcement to three receivers but she cannot. The Byzantine agreement communication protocol (Lamport et al., 1982) prescribes that the sender instead sends the same private message to the receivers who in turn forward to each other the message they have received from the sender. Let the receivers consider the (bitwise) majority of their received messages as a pseudo public message of the sender. We show that this protocol, besides being 1-resilient, substitutes public communication in a very strong sense: every player can consistently believe (Kreps and Wilson, 1982), no matter what messages they have sent or received, that all the receivers hold the same pseudo public message which coincides with the (bitwise) majority of the messages sent by the sender. It follows that the set of sequential equilibrium outcomes of any game (with at least four players) is weakly larger with private communication than with public communication.
abstract_zh: 发送方希望向三位接收者发布公开公告，但无法直接做到。拜占庭协议通信协议（Lamport等，1982）规定，发送方转而向接收者发送相同的私人消息，接收者再将从发送方收到的消息相互转发。让接收者将所收到消息的（按位）多数视为发送方的伪公开消息。我们证明，该协议不仅具有1-弹性，而且在一种很强的意义上替代了公开通信：无论每位玩家发送或接收了何种消息，每位玩家都能一致地相信（Kreps和Wilson，1982），所有接收者持有相同的伪公开消息，该消息与发送方所发送消息的（按位）多数一致。由此可知，在至少包含四位玩家的任何博弈中，私人通信下的序贯均衡结果集合弱大于公开通信下的对应集合。

title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
title_zh: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场
title_primary: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场
title_secondary: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
authors: Jonathan Eaton, Samuel Kortum, Francis Kramarz
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.
abstract_zh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和颗粒度，显示对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们构建了一个企业间匹配的量化一般均衡模型，基于这一洞察，将冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用分离开来。在横截面分析中，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中直接与劳动力竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国各企业劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本的降低与匹配摩擦的减少对法国向新成员国出口增长的贡献相当。尽管工人整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的工人获益较少，甚至在部分加入欧盟的国家中遭受损失。

abstract: We study the long-run effects of a large public expansion of pre-primary education in Argentina. Between 1993 and 1999, the federal government financed the construction of new preschool classrooms targeted to departments with low baseline enrollment and high poverty, creating roughly 186,000 additional places. We link administrative records on classroom construction to four population censuses and estimate difference-in-differences models that compare treated and untreated cohorts across high- and low-construction departments. An additional preschool seat per child increases post-kindergarten schooling by about 0.5 years, raising the probability of completing secondary school by 11.9 percentage points and of attaining any post-secondary education by 7.1 percentage points. For women, access to the program also reduces fertility: an additional seat lowers the number of live births per woman by 0.20. Across several checks using cohort sizes, household composition, province-of-birth restrictions, and direct migration measures, we find little evidence consistent with systematic selective migration, suggesting that migration is unlikely to be a major source of bias in our estimates. Our results show little impact on labor-market outcomes at the census date, consistent with beneficiaries still being in school or in the early stages of their careers. A benefit-cost analysis based on the estimated schooling gains, standard Mincer returns, and observed construction and operating costs yields a benefit-cost ratio of about 11 and an internal rate of return of 13\%. Our findings show that universal at-scale pre-primary expansions in middle-income countries can generate sizable improvements in human capital and demographic outcomes at relatively low fiscal cost.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了阿根廷大规模公立学前教育扩张的长期效应。1993年至1999年间，联邦政府资助新建了针对基线入学率低且贫困程度高的地区的学前教育教室，新增约18.6万个学位。我们将教室建设的行政记录与四次人口普查数据相关联，采用双重差分模型比较高建设密度与低建设密度地区中受政策影响与未受影响的群体。每增加一个儿童学前教育学位，可使幼儿园后的受教育年限提高约0.5年，高中毕业概率提升11.9个百分点，接受高等教育的概率提升7.1个百分点。对女性而言，该政策还降低了生育率：每增加一个学位可使每位女性的活产数减少0.20。通过使用队列规模、家庭构成、出生省份限制及直接迁移指标等多项检验，我们未发现系统性选择性迁移的显著证据，表明迁移不太可能成为估计偏差的主要来源。结果显示，该政策在普查时点对劳动力市场影响甚微，这与受益者仍处于在校或职业生涯早期阶段的情况相符。基于估算的教育收益、标准明瑟回报率以及实际建设与运营成本进行的成本收益分析表明，收益成本比约为11，内部收益率为13%。本研究表明，中等收入国家大规模普及学前教育能以相对较低的财政成本显著提升人力资本与人口结构指标。

abstract: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了中国大型成功制造工厂对其他本地生产者的影响，重点关注20世纪50年代中苏短暂结盟期间建设的“百万卢布工厂”。短暂的地缘政治局势以及盟军与敌军空军基地的位置为工厂选址提供了外生变异。我们发现了一种“繁荣-萧条”模式：1982年，拥有这些工厂的县的生产率比对照组县高出80%，但到2010年却低了20%。这一下降反映了本地企业的表现，这些企业呈现出低生产率、有限创新和高加价的特点。专业化阻碍了溢出效应，阻止了新集群的形成和本地创业精神的发展。

title: What boundary delineation reveals about island evolutionary governance: Multi-level power brokerage in Réunion National Park
title_zh: 边界划定揭示的岛屿演化治理：留尼汪国家公园的多层级权力中介
title_primary: 边界划定揭示的岛屿演化治理：留尼汪国家公园的多层级权力中介
title_secondary: What boundary delineation reveals about island evolutionary governance: Multi-level power brokerage in Réunion National Park
authors: Salwa Aabid, Damien Deschamps, Erwann Lagabrielle
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study analyses the creation of La Réunion National Park (2002–2007) as a strategic and competitive political process embedded within a formal conservation planning framework. Drawing on Evolutionary Governance Theory (EGT), it shows how boundary delineation functioned as a governance instrument that reconfigured power relations between the French state and the Regional Council within a post-colonial, multi-level European outermost context marked by socio-environmental vulnerability and claims for regional autonomy. Combining GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, and semi-structured interviews, the study traces the co-evolution of actors, institutions, discourses, knowledge, and material instruments throughout the park’s spatial planning process. Results, structured along five EGT analytical axes, indicate that boundary delineation constituted a strategic governance process rather than a purely technical exercise. Environmental planning emerged as a political arena in which power relations between the French state and the Regional Council were renegotiated. Scientific expertise and digital tools played a central role in legitimising decisions. Simultaneously, they contributed to filtering and hierarchising competing territorial claims. Participatory processes were formally inclusive but tightly managed, enabling consultation without substantially altering predefined outcomes and resulting in limited boundary changes. Finally, despite stated autonomy-oriented objectives, environmental planning contributed to the production of new social and spatial inequalities, highlighting the ambivalent role of conservation policies in island governance: ensuring both protection and external territorial control. More broadly, the study demonstrates how conservation planning operates as a governance instrument that shapes and reveals land values and power distribution. These findings suggest that boundary delineation should be explicitly treated as a political and governance instrument, requiring greater transparency, stronger accountability, and more substantive inclusion of local actors to avoid reinforcing existing power asymmetries in spatial planning.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了留尼汪国家公园（2002–2007年）的创建过程，将其视为嵌入正式保护规划框架中的战略性与竞争性政治进程。基于演化治理理论（EGT），研究揭示了边界划定如何作为一种治理工具，在面临社会-环境脆弱性与区域自治诉求的后殖民、多层级欧洲最外围地区，重构法国国家与地区议会之间的权力关系。通过结合地理信息系统空间分析、档案研究与半结构化访谈，本研究追溯了公园空间规划过程中行动者、制度、话语、知识与物质工具的协同演化。依据EGT五大分析维度呈现的结果表明，边界划定构成了一种战略性治理过程，而非纯粹的技术性操作。环境规划成为法国国家与地区议会重新协商权力关系的政治场域。科学专业知识与数字工具在决策合法化中发挥核心作用，同时亦对相互竞争的领土诉求进行筛选与等级化。参与过程形式上具有包容性，但受到严格管控，允许协商却未实质性改变预设结果，仅导致有限的边界调整。最终，尽管以自治为导向的目标被明确表述，环境规划却催生了新的社会与空间不平等，凸显了保护政策在岛屿治理中的矛盾角色：既确保保护，又强化外部领土控制。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了保护规划如何作为塑造并反映土地价值与权力分配的治理工具。这些发现表明，边界划定应被明确视为政治与治理工具，需要更高的透明度、更强的问责机制以及更实质性的地方行动者参与，以避免在空间规划中强化既有的权力不对称。

abstract: A lack of longitudinal data has largely prevented the detection of chronic depression among refugees and its intergenerational associations. I link three years of parental depression measures to children’s socio-emotional development and school attendance for Syrian refugees in Jordan. First, chronic depression is common, with over a quarter of adults likely depressed in all three survey rounds. Second, the chronicity of likely parental depression is strongly associated with increasing risk of abnormal child socio-emotional development, and both likely depression and abnormal socio-emotional development are associated with lower school attendance. The results point to caregiver behavior and household tensions as a potential mechanism. Chronic depression among a broadly representative sample of refugees appears to be prevalent and related to urgent child development and human capital needs.
abstract_zh: 纵向数据的缺乏在很大程度上阻碍了对难民慢性抑郁症及其代际关联的检测。我将约旦叙利亚难民父母三年的抑郁测量数据与儿童的社会情感发展及入学情况相联系。首先，慢性抑郁症普遍存在，超过四分之一的成年人在全部三轮调查中可能均处于抑郁状态。其次，父母可能患有慢性抑郁症与儿童异常社会情感发展风险增加密切相关，而可能的抑郁状态及异常社会情感发展均与较低的入学率相关联。研究结果指出，照护者行为及家庭紧张关系可能是潜在的作用机制。在具有广泛代表性的难民样本中，慢性抑郁症似乎普遍存在，并与紧迫的儿童发展及人力资本需求相关。

title: Hemp Cultivation and Crop Diversification: Implications for Ecosystem Services in Kentucky
title_zh: 大麻种植与作物多样化：对肯塔基州生态系统服务的影响
title_primary: 大麻种植与作物多样化：对肯塔基州生态系统服务的影响

authors: Yunsun Park, Seong D. Yun, Brandy E. Phipps, Tyler Mark, Craig Schluttenhofer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the ecosystem benefits of expanding hemp cultivation by assessing its impact on crop diversity. Using scenario‐based simulations and fixed‐effect panel regressions with county‐level data in Kentucky, we find that increased hemp acreage tends to enhance crop diversity, improving water quality and bird diversity. While agricultural policies aimed at small‐scale farmers align with improving farm profitability, broader ecological benefits may remain limited unless they reach a sufficient scale. Our findings suggest that hemp‐induced crop diversification can generate measurable non‐market economic benefits through improvements in water quality and bird diversity, highlighting the need for practical and proactive policy measures that promote smallholder participation.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过评估工业大麻种植对作物多样性的影响，探讨其带来的生态系统效益。基于肯塔基州县级数据的场景模拟与固定效应面板回归分析发现，工业大麻种植面积的增加倾向于提升作物多样性，进而改善水质与鸟类多样性。尽管面向小规模农户的农业政策与提升农场盈利能力的目标相契合，但若未达到足够规模，其更广泛的生态效益可能仍十分有限。研究结果表明，工业大麻引致的作物多样化可通过水质改善与鸟类多样性提升产生可量化的非市场经济效益，这凸显了制定切实可行且积极主动的政策措施以促进小农户参与的必要性。

title: The relationship between pesticides and risk in apple production
title_zh: 农药与苹果生产风险的关系

title_secondary: The relationship between pesticides and risk in apple production
authors: M Casati, L Arata, A Varacca, P Sckokai
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how pesticide expenditure relates to the probability distribution of yield and revenue per hectare in apple production in northern Italy. Using a flexible moment-based approach, we find that pesticide expenditure is negatively associated with downside risk in yield and revenue, whereas late frosts are positively associated with downside risk in yield. Sensitivity analyses show that mean-equation estimates are robust to unobserved confounders, while negative semi-variance models are less robust overall. Only the pesticide–expected outcome relationship appears plausibly causal. Therefore, conclusions about pesticides as risk-increasing or risk-decreasing inputs should be made with caution.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利北部苹果生产中农药支出与每公顷产量及收益概率分布之间的关系。采用灵活的基于矩的方法，我们发现农药支出与产量和收益的下行风险呈负相关，而晚霜则与产量的下行风险呈正相关。敏感性分析表明，均值方程估计对未观测到的混杂因素具有稳健性，而负半方差模型整体稳健性较弱。只有农药与预期结果之间的关系似乎具有合理的因果性。因此，关于农药作为风险增加或风险减少投入的结论应谨慎得出。

title: Business travel, institutions, and economic complexity
title_zh: 商务旅行、制度与经济复杂性
title_primary: 商务旅行、制度与经济复杂性
title_secondary: Business travel, institutions, and economic complexity
authors: Imran Arif
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: While international knowledge transfer drives structural transformation, the diffusion of tacit knowledge—the complex skills and procedures essential for sophisticated production—remains constrained by the need for face-to-face interaction. This paper identifies outbound business travel as a distinct channel for overcoming this friction. Exploiting a panel of 113 countries (1995–2020) and a System GMM framework to address endogeneity, I document a robust positive association between business travel and economic complexity. I show that this relationship is conditional on domestic political institutions: the returns to travel are amplified in inclusive, open political environments but vanish in highly centralized systems. Furthermore, I find evidence of diminishing marginal returns, suggesting that the benefits of travel moderate as connectivity channels saturate. I conclude that inclusive institutions function as a critical “absorptive filter” mechanism, enabling the tacit knowledge acquired abroad to translate effectively into national productive capabilities.
abstract_zh: 尽管国际知识转移推动着结构性转型，但隐性知识——复杂生产所需的关键技能与流程——的传播仍受限于面对面互动的需求。本文指出，出境商务差旅是克服这一摩擦的独特渠道。基于113个国家1995-2020年的面板数据，并采用系统GMM框架处理内生性问题，本文证实商务差旅与经济复杂度之间存在稳健的正向关联。研究表明，这一关系受国内政治制度调节：在包容开放的政治环境中，差旅的回报效应被放大，但在高度集权体制下则完全消失。此外，本文发现边际回报递减的证据，表明随着连通渠道趋于饱和，差旅收益将逐步减弱。结论指出，包容性制度作为关键的"吸收过滤"机制，能够使海外获取的隐性知识有效转化为国家生产能力。

title: Bootstrap Model Averaging
title_primary: Bootstrap Model Averaging
authors: Minghui Song, Guohua Zou, Alan T. K. Wan
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Model averaging has garnered significant attention in recent years for its ability to combine information from multiple models. A critical challenge in frequentist model averaging is determining the appropriate weight vector. The bootstrap method, well-known for its desirable properties, offers a promising solution. In this article, we propose a bootstrap model averaging approach that selects weights by minimizing a bootstrap-based criterion. Notably, our weight selection criterion can also be interpreted as bootstrap aggregating. When all candidate models are misspecified, we show that the resulting estimator is asymptotically optimal, achieving the minimum possible squared error loss. Furthermore, we establish the convergence rate of the bootstrap weights toward the theoretically optimal weights. In scenarios where correct candidate models exist within a nested set and the number of covariates is fixed, we derive the limiting distribution of our proposed model averaging estimator. Through simulation studies and empirical applications, we demonstrate that our proposed method often outperforms other commonly used model selection and model averaging techniques, and other bootstrap-based variants.

title: Tasks and the gender wage gap in urban China, 2002 –2023
title_zh: 2002-2023年中国城市工作任务与性别工资差距
title_primary: 2002-2023年中国城市工作任务与性别工资差距
title_secondary: Tasks and the gender wage gap in urban China, 2002 –2023
authors: Xinxin Ma, Jiachen Han, Shi Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study uses national survey data from the Chinese Household Income Project for 2002, 2013, and 2023 to examine the influence of task-based factors on the gender wage gap (GWG) in urban China in 2002–2023. We construct multi-period indicators of non-routine task intensity and employ decomposition methods to explore two channels through which tasks influence the GWG. The results indicate that the wage premium for non-routine tasks was higher for women than for men during the period 2002–2023, and several robustness checks support this conclusion. The gender differences in the non-routine task wage premium vary by age and education group, and across the wage distribution. The decomposition results suggest that gender disparities in wage premiums for non-routine tasks (the price effect) contributed to narrowing the GWG in all three sample periods, although the magnitude of this effect declined from 2002 to 2023. By contrast, gender differences in the allocation of non-routine tasks (the endowment effect) widened the GWG in 2002 and 2023, while narrowed it in 2013. Additionally, both the endowment and price effects on the GWG differ across wage distributions in each period.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国家庭收入调查2002年、2013年及2023年的全国性数据，考察了基于任务的因素对2002至2023年间中国城镇性别工资差距的影响。我们构建了非例行任务强度的多时期指标，并采用分解方法探索任务影响性别工资差距的两条途径。结果显示，在2002至2023年期间，女性在非例行任务上的工资溢价高于男性，且多项稳健性检验支持这一结论。非例行任务工资溢价的性别差异在不同年龄、教育群体及工资分布上表现各异。分解结果表明，非例行任务工资溢价的性别差异（价格效应）在三个样本期内均有助于缩小性别工资差距，尽管该效应从2002年到2023年有所减弱。相比之下，非例行任务分配上的性别差异（禀赋效应）在2002年和2023年扩大了性别工资差距，而在2013年则缩小了该差距。此外，各时期工资分布上的禀赋效应和价格效应对性别工资差距的影响亦存在差异。

title: China's rare earth policy: Prosperity maximization or great power geoeconomics?
title_zh: 中国稀土政策：繁荣最大化还是大国地缘经济？
title_primary: 中国稀土政策：繁荣最大化还是大国地缘经济？
title_secondary: China's rare earth policy: Prosperity maximization or great power geoeconomics?
authors: Konrad, Kai A.
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: An industrial economics analysis of China's quasi-monopoly on refined rare earth materials shows: even if China strictly maximizes national prosperity and abstains from geopolitical power play, a significant price differential emerges between the export price and the price for domestic users. The price differential itself is not evidence of geopolitical intentions. However, this equilibrium price gap widens if we assume that China views itself as contesting in a geopolitical, tournament-like situation against the United States. These two results are derived within the framework of a tournament model that imbeds the characteristics of a dominant supplier with a fringe - market, but adds geopolitical goals to the dominant supplier's objective.
abstract_zh: 对中国精炼稀土材料准垄断地位的产业经济学分析表明：即便中国严格以国家繁荣最大化为目标，不涉足地缘政治博弈，其出口价格与国内用户价格之间仍会出现显著价差。这一价差本身并不构成地缘政治意图的证据。然而，若假设中国视自身处于与美国的地缘政治竞赛情境中，这一均衡价格差距将进一步扩大。上述两项结论均基于一个锦标赛模型框架推导得出，该模型融合了主导供应商与边缘市场的特征，并在主导供应商的目标函数中加入了地缘政治考量。

title: When wine walked into grocery stores: Examining the (un)intended economic consequences of wine Sale reform in Tennessee
title_zh: 当葡萄酒走进杂货店：田纳西州葡萄酒销售改革的（非）预期经济后果研究
title_primary: 当葡萄酒走进杂货店：田纳西州葡萄酒销售改革的（非）预期经济后果研究
title_secondary: When wine walked into grocery stores: Examining the (un)intended economic consequences of wine Sale reform in Tennessee
authors: Jiayu Sun, Vincenzina Caputo, Aaron J. Staples, Achilleas Vassilopoulos
official: 官方在线 2025-12-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Alcohol policy liberalization is a contentious issue in the United States, including debates over whether grocery stores should be allowed to sell wine. This issue reflects a dilemma between accommodating consumer convenience, promoting wine industry growth, and generating tax revenue, versus concerns about potential harm to liquor stores. However, there is a lack of empirical studies evaluating the dual impacts of wine sales liberalization following policy reforms. This study uses synthetic control methods and synthetic difference-in-differences to provide robust evidence on the impact that wine sale liberalization has on liquor store closures, employment outcomes, and wine excise tax revenue. Drawing on proprietary NielsenIQ data and official government statistics, the study provides a multidimensional assessment of how a 2016 Tennessee policy reform affected wine sales and supply chain dynamics. The results suggest that allowing grocery stores to sell wine had a statistically insignificant impact on the number of liquor stores, while also increasing wine excise tax revenue. However, there is mixed evidence of a potential short-term decline in liquor store employment, where the statistical significance of the point estimate depends on the statistical approach. Recognizing that policy reform can have unintended economic consequences, these results provide valuable, policy-relevant insights for stakeholders navigating the evolving landscape of alcohol distribution.
abstract_zh: 酒精政策自由化在美国是一个有争议的问题，包括是否允许杂货店销售葡萄酒的辩论。这一问题反映了在满足消费者便利、促进葡萄酒产业发展及增加税收收入与担忧对酒类专卖店可能造成损害之间的两难困境。然而，关于政策改革后葡萄酒销售自由化的双重影响，缺乏实证研究。本研究采用合成控制法和合成双重差分法，为葡萄酒销售自由化对酒类专卖店关闭、就业结果及葡萄酒消费税收入的影响提供了稳健证据。基于专有的NielsenIQ数据和官方政府统计数据，本研究对2016年田纳西州政策改革如何影响葡萄酒销售及供应链动态进行了多维度评估。结果表明，允许杂货店销售葡萄酒对酒类专卖店数量在统计上无显著影响，同时增加了葡萄酒消费税收入。然而，存在混合证据表明酒类专卖店就业可能短期下降，其点估计的统计显著性取决于所采用的统计方法。鉴于政策改革可能带来意想不到的经济后果，这些结果为应对酒精分销格局不断演变的相关利益方提供了有价值的、与政策相关的见解。
